Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/libidn2/fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":58,"var":"data/size","code":"if ((size & 3) == 0) { uint32_t *u32 = (uint32_t *) malloc(size + 4); char *out2 = (char *) malloc(64); ... idn2_to_ascii_4i((uint32_t *) data, size / 4, out2, flags[it]); }","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are reinterpreted as UCS-4 code points and passed to the vulnerable API when the input length is a multiple of 4."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/idn2/lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_to_ascii_4i","line":581,"var":"input_u32/input_u8","code":"input_u32 = (uint32_t *) malloc ((inlen + 1) * sizeof(uint32_t)); ... input_u8 = u32_to_u8 (input_u32, inlen + 1, NULL, &length);","note":"The UCS-4 input is copied and converted to UTF-8 before lookup, preserving the attacker-controlled label contents."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libidn2/lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_lookup_u8","line":420,"var":"src","code":"rc = idn2_lookup_u8 (input_u8, &output_u8, flags);","note":"The converted UTF-8 string is routed into the lookup pipeline that builds the ASCII DNS label output."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libidn2/lib/lookup.c","function":"label","line":618,"var":"output","code":"if (output) strcpy (output, (const char *) output_u8);","note":"On success, the function copies the produced label into the caller buffer with strcpy, assuming the buffer has room for at least 63 characters plus NUL."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libidn2/fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":64,"var":"out2","code":"char *out2 = (char *) malloc(64); ... idn2_to_ascii_4i((uint32_t *) data, size / 4, out2, flags[it]);","note":"The fuzzer allocates exactly 64 bytes for the destination, so any output longer than 63 characters overflows this heap buffer during strcpy."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('wrote trace')
